## NEWEST: August 25, 2026 — TWO MAJOR ENTRIES, BOTH REPORTED 2026-08-26

### Aug 25 — "Browser extensions, site tools, and cloud sign-in"  *** 3 findings ***
(a) SITE TOOLS = WebMCP.  REPORTED HIGH/AIRT.  Doc: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/webmcp
    - A website registers tools in ordinary page JS via **document.modelContext.registerTool()**
      with: name, description, input schema, execute handler calling the app's OWN logic,
      annotations (e.g. readOnlyHint).
    - ChatGPT Work and Codex in the DESKTOP APP'S BUILT-IN BROWSER (and ChatGPT Sites)
      **discover tools automatically on page load** and invoke them.
    - NO install, NO marketplace, NO config file, NO server, NO on-disk artifact.
      Tool set exists only for the LIFETIME OF THE PAGE => capability is a function of NAVIGATION,
      not configuration. (Different problem from the 08-24 Kiro/mcp.json gap: there is no artifact.)
    - Tools run against the SITE'S EXISTING AUTHENTICATED SESSION (execute handler = site's own code,
      site's own permissions).
    - OpenAI's own words: "Website-provided tool definitions and results are untrusted content";
      "tool names alone don't prove function or scope"; "These checks reduce risk; they don't make a
      website or its output trustworthy."
    - Controls: per-invocation safety review; browser ties invocations to originating page; normal
      website-access/confirmation policies for consequential actions (messages, purchases, deleting
      data, changing permissions); "Site tools" button in the ADDRESS BAR lists them;
      disable at Settings > Browser > Permissions. ALL USER-FACING — no tenant policy documented.
    - Requires **GPT-5.6 Sol or Terra**. Luna has WebMCP DISABLED.
    - *** NOT AVAILABLE IN ENTERPRISE OR EDU WORKSPACES *** => lands on the least-managed tiers.
    - WebMCP Challenge partners: Chromium Dev, Cloudflare, Shopify, Vercel, Render, Netlify.
(b) BROWSER EXTENSION now on **Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi** + Chrome. REPORTED MED/ENDPOINT.
    - Install via Settings > Computer Use ("More browsers" expander); select per chat by @-mention
      against the SPECIFIC BROWSER PROFILE where the extension was installed.
    - All five support tab mentions + browser control; Opera lacks side chat.
    - Per-browser **allowlist / blocklist of domains** under "Manage" — USER-set, not admin-set.
    - Doc: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/chrome-extension and /docs/computer-use
(c) CLOUD BROWSER WEBSITE SIGN-IN. REPORTED MED/ENDPOINT (same finding as (b)).
    - ChatGPT Work on WEB, iOS and ANDROID can prompt the user to sign in to a supported website
      "through the cloud browser"; login details entered IN THE SIGN-IN FLOW, not in chat
      => the auth event is NOT in the transcript.
    - Cloud browser sessions are ISOLATED FROM LOCAL BROWSERS => authenticated third-party session
      lives entirely in OpenAI-hosted infra, invisible to any endpoint collector.
    - *** EXCLUDED FROM ENTERPRISE AND EDU WORKSPACES ***
    - Doc: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/browser

### Aug 25 — "Trigger scheduled tasks from Gmail, Slack, and GitHub events"  REPORTED HIGH/AIDR
Doc: learn.chatgpt.com/docs/automations
- Tasks fire on EVENTS, not a clock:
    Gmail  — new message, filterable by SENDER or SUBJECT
    Slack  — new message in a WATCHED CHANNEL (ChatGPT Slack app must be a MEMBER of that channel)
    GitHub — PR activity in an AUTHORIZED github.com repo: reviews, comments, commit updates, merges
             (GitHub app needs repository access)
- Setup: Settings > Apps to connect, then describe event+action in Work; user reviews
  **Trigger / Condition / Prompt** and completes authorization.
- **Time-based schedules and event triggers CANNOT COEXIST on one task.**
- **Clustered events may be COMBINED INTO A SINGLE RUN** => external-content-to-agent-run mapping is
  many-to-one and NOT reconstructable from the run alone.
- Pending events / manual runs under "Scheduled".
- Plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu + ChatGPT for Healthcare workspaces.
- WHY IT MATTERS: the INITIATING PARTY is now whoever AUTHORED THE TRIGGERING CONTENT, and for all
  three sources that is frequently EXTERNAL. Indirect prompt injection with the delivery problem
  solved. The "filter by sender/subject" is attacker-observable and attacker-satisfiable, not a control.
  The standing grant outlives the user's attention — no human in the session.
